name: @aisha/llm-dispatch
description: Multi-provider LLM dispatch — the BackendRegistry + per-provider InferenceBackend implementations (OpenAI, Gemini native generateContent, Anthropic /v1/messages, vLLM/Ollama, llm-gateway, maestro). Shared so every service that resolves a backend via aisha_resolve_clow_backend dispatches to the NATIVE provider protocol with one import, instead of blindly POSTing /chat/completions.
